---
title: "Contact"
toc: false
---

I am seeking internships and entry-level roles in bioinformatics, plant science and agritech in
the UAE and internationally. Use the form to get in touch or to request my CV.

```{=html}
<div class="contact-grid">
  <form id="contact-form" class="contact-form" method="POST" action="">
    <label>Your name <input type="text" name="name" required></label>
    <label>Your email <input type="email" name="email" required></label>
    <label>Subject
      <select name="subject">
        <option>General enquiry</option>
        <option>Request for CV</option>
        <option>Internship or role</option>
        <option>Collaboration</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>Message <textarea name="message" rows="6" required></textarea></label>
    <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off">
    <button type="submit" class="btn-cute solid">Send message</button>
    <p class="form-note" id="form-note"></p>
  </form>
  <div class="contact-aside">
    <h3>Other ways to reach me</h3>
    <p><strong>Email</strong><br>
      <span id="email-text">halireenarush@gmail.com</span>
      <button type="button" class="btn-copy" id="copy-email">Copy</button></p>
    <p><strong>LinkedIn</strong><br><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/halireena">linkedin.com/in/halireena</a></p>
    <p><strong>GitHub</strong><br><a href="https://github.com/halireena">github.com/halireena</a></p>
    <p class="small">Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
  // Form delivery is handled by Formspree. Paste your form ID between the quotes below.
  const FORMSPREE_ID = "";
  const form = document.getElementById("contact-form");
  const note = document.getElementById("form-note");
  if (FORMSPREE_ID) {
    form.action = "https://formspree.io/f/" + FORMSPREE_ID;
    form.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      note.textContent = "Sending…";
      try {
        const r = await fetch(form.action, { method: "POST", body: new FormData(form), headers: { Accept: "application/json" } });
        if (r.ok) { form.reset(); note.textContent = "Thank you. Your message has been sent."; }
        else { note.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please email me directly instead."; }
      } catch { note.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please email me directly instead."; }
    });
  } else {
    form.querySelector("button[type=submit]").disabled = true;
    note.textContent = "The form is not connected yet. Please use the email address on the right.";
  }
  document.getElementById("copy-email").addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
    const txt = document.getElementById("email-text").textContent;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt); e.target.textContent = "Copied"; }
    catch { window.prompt("Copy this address:", txt); }
    setTimeout(() => { e.target.textContent = "Copy"; }, 2000);
  });
</script>
```
